exactPrompt: Use case: original mobile game sprite. Draw Moon Shadow, our chibi Daoist swordswoman, as exactly THREE transparent walking key poses in one horizontal PNG. Equal square cells with clean transparent gutters and no text or floors. Reference 1 is the exact existing character and view; reference 2 is the native action position/order, reference 3 magnifies native legs and arms. Use references 2 and 3 for action anatomy only. References 4 and 5 set the original hand-painted Chinese Daoist Q finish only. Render silver bob hair, navy and gold hairflower, navy scarf, ivory sleeves, navy coat with brushed gold embroidered moon/cloud motifs, dark blue cuffed trousers, gold-striped navy boots and ONE silver crescent blade held firmly in EACH hand, blades distinct and separated. Preserve exact costume, face or back-of-head and camera across all three panels. Short same-scale body, same head and belt height and consistent proportions. This is a compact steady walk. Arms move slightly and each blade follows its own hand. No leaps, high knees, lunges, oversized feet, detached weapons, shadows, captions, panel lines, backdrop, glow or checkerboard. Actual transparent background, 12% horizontal clear gutter around each character, clean silhouette for small mobile size. Strict side profile facing SCREEN LEFT, one visible purple eye, silver bob with gold-blue flower and navy scarf flowing SCREEN RIGHT. Show both attached compact legs with two distinct navy boots, toes aimed LEFT. Ref 2 and 3 BOTTOM row, left to right. f15 blink, one closed eyelid, two boots almost overlap under hips with sliver of shaded toe a little farther left. f16 eye open, leading LEFT boot visibly raised off ground and tilted slightly upward, trailing RIGHT boot planted flat. Swing nearer sleeve and held blade a little toward front (LEFT). f17 eye open, leading LEFT boot now flat and lowest, rear RIGHT boot heel lifts a little behind, toes near ground. Keep held blades swinging toward front, one blade per hand. Do not hide all of either blade or redraw her face as a three-quarter front view.
